text:
claire: kicking off change window for embeddings-service v1.5.0 to prod-global. rollout plan: canary 3% for 12m -> 30% for 18m. gating: embed latency p99, 429 rate (client-side rate-limiter), and error-budget burn. starting 3% canary now, will watch dashboards.

deploy-bot: rollout started by claire. env=prod-global, version=v1.5.0. steps=[3%:12m,30%:18m]. auto-rollback: enabled on p99>900ms or 429s>0.8% sustained 3m. annotating change window.

slo-watcher-bot: baseline snapshot: embed_p99=85ms, 429 baseline=0.02%. current window p99=88ms, 429=0.03%. no hard alarm yet. will post deltas at +6m.

ben: quick FYI — I see a small uptick in 429s from a specific client pool (mobile-app-v2) ~4m after the canary. routing shows the canary target included those IP ranges. not huge yet but notable.

tara: tracing: longer tail on embed_encode stage on some pods, plus a small retry loop in client SDK that amplifies 429s into bursts. attaching sample logs.

observability-bot: delta(5m pre vs 5m post): embed_p99 +120ms for /embed/text on a subset of pods in us-east and eu-west. 429 delta +0.25% concentrated to mobile-app-v2 traffic. top pods: emb-9, emb-11. Recommendation: temporarily exclude mobile-app-v2 from canary or apply client-side retry jitter.

claire: hold progression. keep at 3%. can we quickly reroute the 3% canary traffic away from the mobile-app-v2 client pool and re-run deltas? also consider pinning to v1.4.8 if 429s persist.

deploy-bot: rerouting canary: removing traffic from client-pool mobile-app-v2 for canary subset. change window note appended: "excluded mobile-app-v2 from canary".

infra-bot: note: I can provision a warmed-pool with larger mem/heap to isolate embed pods if we want a warmed-only path; ETA ~2m.

ben: post-reroute 3m check: 429s down to baseline 0.03% -> 0.035% and embed_p99 trending down to 105ms from 210ms on affected pods. still seeing occasional retry amplification from older SDKs.

tara: logs show error: `2026-03-23T09:12:11Z WARN retry: immediate retry without jitter for client-sdk v2.1.0`. we should either block that client version for canary or add a temporary client-side throttling rule in the gateway.

claire: decision: keep canary at 3% but excluded mobile-app-v2; add a gateway rule to apply per-client backoff for SDK v2.1.0 to prevent tight retries. do NOT advance to 30% until stable for 15m. if 429s exceed 0.5% or p99>700ms for 3m, we will pin back to v1.4.8. deploy-bot, please annotate change window with decision and the action items for release notes.

deploy-bot: actions: canary reroute applied; gateway temporary backoff rule deployed for client-sdk v2.1.0. change window note appended: "paused advance - excluded mobile-app-v2 + gateway backoff rule applied". auto-rollback remains armed. Incident created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4402.

observability-bot: 6m post-action snapshot: embed_p99 for canary pods stabilizing at ~110ms; 429 global 0.04%. no hard SLO breach. continuing 15m watch.

infra-bot: warmed-pool ready if needed; standing by.

ben: filing follow-up ticket to notify mobile app team about SDK jitter fix and request rollout of patched client: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3199.

claire: thanks team. i'll update release notes with the pause rationale, mitigation steps, and follow-ups (notify mobile app, consider warmed-only ramp). sync in 20m. :white_check_mark:
